text:
alex: Heads-up — getting multiple inference hangs in eu-north1 after last night's system package rollout. Appears limited to mixed-interconnect nodes (PCIe + NVLink). Alerts show repeated NCCL timeouts and p2p errors. Pager INF-4021 fired. Anyone picking this up?

maya: Seeing the same on nodepool gpu-mix-2. Host libs were bumped (libnccl.so) but containers still have older nccl. Possible host/container mismatch. Logs: "NCCL ERROR TIMEOUT" and "p2p copy failed".

dmitri: Repro'd locally on staging with a minimal allgather across 4 GPUs when one rank picked PCIe route and others NVLink. Quick repro (trimmed):
```python
# run on mixed topology nodes
import torch, torch.distributed as dist
dist.init_process_group('nccl')
# perform allgather many times -> hang after ~30 iters
```
Symptoms match a p2p path-selection race. Confirmed with NCCL 2.28.4 + CUDA 12.2.

jess: Oncall here. Quick mitigation: rolling back host libnccl to previous package in a canary helped in my smoke test. Recommend pausing any further libnccl rollouts in eu-north1 :warning:.

alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) pause rollout in eu-north1; 2) pin host libnccl back to known-good; 3) set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS as temporary cluster-wide env to force sys copies and avoid NVLink P2P path variance. Note SYS will increase host CPU copy overhead.

maya: DaemonSet command to flip env for gpu nodes:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env ds/gpu-nodes NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS
```
That will apply to new pods; need rolling restart for current ones.

dmitri: Important: SYS disables direct NVLink P2P and falls back to host-mediated copies. Expect throughput drop ~10-15% in microbenchmarks — rough cost impact +~12% token cost for affected region while workaround active. Filed INF-4021 with perf numbers.

alex: I'll coordinate the rollback. deploy-bot: start canary rollback for eu-north1 nodes (gpu-canary-1..3).

deploy-bot: deploy: rollback-libnccl job queued. Targets: gpu-canary-1,gpu-canary-2,gpu-canary-3. ETA ~7m.

maya: Canary nodes back to healthy state after rollback. No more NCCL timeouts in syslog. Autoscaler stable.

jess: Good. Action items: (a) halt further host lib upgrades until compat tests added; (b) add mixed-interconnect collective tests to pre-rollout suite; (c) notify SRE and Customer Success with impact summary for customers in eu-north1.

dmitri: Also adding a prerelease kernel/driver check to detect mismatches and warn if topology is mixed (NVLink+PCIe) since thats the trigger.

alex: Drafting incident note now. TL;DR: host nccl bump caused mixed-interconnect collective hang in eu-north1; immediate rollback to previous libnccl resolved canaries; mitigation (NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS) available if needed; impact: ~22 jobs affected (~0.9% fleet) with retries; cost impact small. Tracking INF-4021 and ROLLBACK-1973.

jess: Thanks — @maya can you add that e2e to nightlies? :thumbsup:

maya: On it, ETA by tomorrow morning.

alex: I'll follow up with release team to update rollout gating (add mixed-interconnect smoke).

dmitri: If anyone needs the raw perf dumps / traces I saved them under s3://redwood-debug/perf/INF-4021/ — includes nccl trace logs and topology maps.

jess: Closing loop here. Marking eu-north1 rollout paused until we have compat tests and signoff.

(End of thread)
